title: Aurora Mobile App: trip, connection or deploy

ma_what.text: What's wrong in the Aurora Mobile App?
ma_what.help: A Software Verification check that completes on its own or shows green is expected. Carry on to Trip Data Sync.
ma_what.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow

options.label: Can't find the mission or trip
Pull done, but can't get to Trip Data Sync
options.issue: can't proceed to Trip Data Sync

steps: Ask Dispatch to confirm the correct cloud environment for the mission: PRE-PROD, PROD, DEV or STAGING.
Make sure the Aurora Mobile App is set to that same environment.
Look for the mission or trip again.
ma_env.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow

ma_disc.text: Check the environment and the stack
steps: Ask Dispatch to confirm the correct cloud environment for the mission: PRE-PROD, PROD, DEV or STAGING.
Make sure the Aurora Mobile App is set to that same environment.
Verify the vehicle is in the IDLE stack (Scout shows this). If it isn't, have RAS place it in IDLE, or use Scout.
ma_disc.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow

steps: Run the cold start steps for your platform: !coldstart (a579m), !volvocoldstart (asvat) or !a2cs (LTS).
Check the Aurora Mobile App again.
ma_disc_cs.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow
ma_disc_cs.help: The ! commands come up when you send them to yourself as a Slack direct message.

ma_sv.text: Have Dispatch check the release configuration and remote deploy
steps: Ask Dispatch to confirm the current vehicle release configuration, and that remote deploy is enabled in Logistics Management.
If a correction is needed, have Dispatch make it, then wait a few minutes.
The task should then appear in the Aurora Mobile App.
ma_sv.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow

ma_dep.text: Check stack, services and network, then reattempt
steps: Confirm you're in the IDLE stack.
Confirm stack service is connected.
Confirm system deploy service is connected.
Confirm the Office network is connected.
Reattempt the deploy.
ma_dep.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow

ma_stuck.text: Turn remote deploy off and on, then repull
steps: Disable remote deploy.
Wait 2 minutes.
Enable remote deploy.
Repull software through the Aurora Mobile App.
ma_stuck.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow
ma_stuck.help: For when the software pull succeeded and the cold start is done, but you still can't proceed to Trip Data Sync. Elsewhere in this section the guide has Dispatch confirm and correct remote deploy settings.

ma_tds.text: Retry the task from the Idle stack
steps: Retry the failed task.
Make sure you're in the Idle stack (confirm with Scout). If you aren't, move the vehicle to IDLE or !coldstart, then try this step again.
If the vehicle successfully pulled software, !coldstart and try this step again.
ma_tds.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow

ma_forvis.text: Working again without VRE. Post a /vreforvis with the steps you took, a sysreport if possible, and how long you spent troubleshooting.
ma_forvis.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Purpose

details: Screenshot: the Aurora Mobile App screen, including which environment it's set to.
ma_esc.text: Still not working. Escalate to VRE in a #vops_troubleshooting thread (Scout Troubleshooter or /vrehelp) and paste the handoff.
ma_esc.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Aurora Mobile App Workflow
